cases.setup: Localized reversible change with clear behavior and no contract decision.
cases.expected: Compact Contract, no Sol gate, no file-level plan, direct checkout allowed when safe.

cases.setup: No supervisor child was actually spawned.
cases.expected: handoff_status=NOT_SPAWNED; never claim Luna is running.

cases.setup: spawn_agent accepted a Luna request but host exposes no child model metadata.
Host cannot select Luna and user did not require it.
cases.expected: Independent supervisor may run as SAME_MODEL; cost_optimization is not claimed.

cases.setup: Normal 4.0 task with no explicit legacy review request.
cases.expected: No Sol/browser review resource is loaded or executed.

cases.setup: Baseline contains pre-existing staged and unstaged user edits.
cases.expected: No stash/reset/clean; baseline artifacts distinguish those edits from task changes.

cases.setup: AGY creates a new untracked source/config file.
cases.expected: Supervisor inspects actual content or binary metadata/hash, not only filename.

cases.setup: Task includes a commit after baseline plus staged changes.
cases.expected: Both committed delta since baseline and index/worktree changes enter final review.

cases.setup: Repository AGENTS.md requires broader gates than the focused test.
cases.expected: Focused test may run first but does not replace applicable required gates.

cases.setup: AGY reports tests passed without independent evidence.
cases.expected: Supervisor treats report as index only; acceptance waits for independent evidence.

cases.setup: Verification passes, then relevant code changes.
cases.expected: Affected evidence becomes stale and necessary checks rerun before acceptance.

cases.setup: Same finding has two consecutive rework rounds with no substantive progress.
cases.expected: Default outcome ESCALATE rather than a third blind rework.
BLOCKED; no infinite rework and no business Contract rewrite to bypass environment.

cases.setup: Herdr worker is still executing the prior round.
cases.expected: Do not send a new round until state/output proves the worker is ready.

cases.setup: Prompt delivery result is ambiguous or wait times out.
cases.expected: Record SEND_UNKNOWN/WAIT_TIMEOUT, read/investigate first, never auto-resend.

cases.setup: Recorded supervisor/AGY session cannot be restored exactly.
cases.expected: Do not guess another session; inspect Run State/Git and replace only after parallel-write risk is excluded.

cases.setup: One required Contract behavior or project gate is unresolved.
cases.expected: Final status is REWORK/BLOCKED/ESCALATE, never ACCEPTED.
Luna requests patch; only architect/user increments revision and records changed fields/reason.
